title: An Edge AI Approach for Low-Power, Real-Time Atrial Fibrillation Detection on Wearable Devices Based on Heartbeat Intervals.
summary: The full article tests 1D-CNN models on ECG-annotated RR-interval sequences and deploys a prototype on an ARM microcontroller; test accuracy improves with longer RR windows (0.963, 0.976, 0.980 for 25, 50, 100 intervals). This is a bounded AF-recognition proof of concept on annotated data, not clinical screening validation.
